dedupe_keys.name: california school facility program funding office of public school construction

description: This dataset lists all projects funded under California's School Facility Program, the voter-approved school construction programme of about 42 billion US dollars that the Office of Public School Construction administers as staff to the State Allocation Board. The table held 14,506 project records when read, with county, district and school, programme, application number and applicant, flags for preliminary, full, site and design, site-only, design-only and environmental hardship applications, pupil grants requested by level (elementary, middle, high, non-severe and severe special education), grade level of the project, state share of funding, site acquisition, financial hardship, charter facility lease and career technical education loan amounts, joint-use facility and partner type, industry sector, portables replaced, the last State Allocation Board date and status; a data dictionary is provided. Coverage: California public school districts. Access: free CSV and API on data.ca.gov (updated September 2026). Licence: not specified. Caveats: records describe funding applications, not building condition or completion. Simulation uses: modelling school construction and modernisation pipelines and replacing portable classrooms in state facility planning. Related records: the NCES school locations and the NCSI facility condition assessment workbook.
